description: t.a, dispatched first at 0, locks m and holds it until 300. t.b (r.side) and t.c (r.main) yield, then wait at 0, t.b with lock_until deadline 1000 and t.c with deadline 2000; each deadline Sleep registers its timer. r.side is cancelled at 100: t.b's next poll observes the cancel at its checkpoint, gives up its place and drops its Sleep (timer cancelled). The unlock at 300 hands the lock to t.c, whose Sleep is dropped on acquisition.
